description.fallback: After the accident, the group wonders if the car that tricked them into the accident with a truck was a Stand. They keep moving at a slower pace to avoid another meeting. Jotaro suggests they leave the destroyed truck behind and act as if nothing happened.

intro.fallback: After the accident, the group wonders if the car that tricked them into the accident with a truck was a Stand.
They keep moving at a slower pace to avoid another meeting.
Jotaro suggests they leave the destroyed truck behind and act as if nothing happened.

text.fallback: Head out: Wheel of Fortune, Part 2

outro.fallback: They eventually find out that they were tricked again by the driver of the mysterious car, who quickly leaves the scene before they can see him.
The group gives chase and are led by the car to a closed road where the car attacks them from behind, trying to push them off of the cliff.
